subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Generic runtime object layer reconstructed from the wave-002 scene/resource/audio packet: scene-graph render resource management (draw-element and bucket arrays), resource-object construction and range-gated configuration, resource registry linked-list management with flag-classified counters, mesh and texture resource loading, audio network stream and sound-source teardown, and module-level audio/callback helpers.

summary: Reconstructs the generic runtime object layer from twenty validated functions. Three DERIVED classes carry the strongest evidence: SceneGraphRenderResourceManager (0x00543FA0) for draw-element/bucket allocation and scene-graph/audio walks, ResourceObject (0x00546250, 0x00546F30, 0x00546F70, 0x00547040, 0x005470A0) for the 196-byte resource object and its range-gated setter family, and AudioNetworkStreamManager (0x00544AF0) for audio stream/sub-stream teardown against two tree lists and stream-handle globals. One GUESS class ResourceManager merges the resource registry list operations (0x005474D0 create/reuse, 0x00547670 append, 0x00547710 remove, 0x005487A0/0x005487E0 walks) on shared +0x24 head / +0xC0 next / counter offsets. GUESS classes MeshResourceManager, TextureResourceManager, SceneGraphNode, AudioNetworkNode and SoundSource cover the loaders and node/destructor types. Three functions (0x00545F40 getter, 0x00545F50 audio load-ratio callback, 0x005461B0 mutex cleanup) stay unowned. One GUESS interface IResourceConfigurator groups the gated setter family; one GUESS state machine models the dword_8B8EF8 audio buffer load-state dispatch. Four DERIVED compatibility contracts capture resource construction, list counters, audio teardown and vertex-buffer bucket rebuild. Field semantics and several owner identities remain unresolved.

function_roles.role: Vertex-buffer resource (re)allocation for scene rendering: frees the existing 24-byte draw-element array (count +0x14C, ptr +0x150), reallocates it sized by the +0x64 element count, walks the scene-graph list (+0x100) and audio list (+0x108) with SceneGraphRenderWalk (0x0054BD30), runs the audio-list walk with AudioNetworkTreeWalker (0x00544D30), and, when master flags (+0xEC) bit 0x4 is clear, runs the UI/list cleanup chain (0x005487A0, 0x00548810, 0x00544740, 0x00545A10, 0x00545A40, 0x00545BB0). Re-allocates four 528-byte bucket arrays (+0x1B8/+0x1C0/+0x1C8/+0x1D0) from counts mirrored at +0x1B4..+0x1CC/+0x44..+0x50, classifies draw elements by flag bits 0x20/0x100 via 0x00548850, and builds the vertex-format descriptor from element flags and per-material data (pointer sentinels 0x00800000/0x00804000, material-type switch) with 0x005414E0 gating on 0x008B78A0. Returns 0 on success, -1 on walk failures.

Audio network stream teardown: when owner flags (+0xEC) have bit 0x100000 set, destroys the sub-stream array (count +0x160, stride 96, 0x005502C0), unlinks it (0x005478B0), zeroes +0x160/+0x164, frees the shared audio buffer global 0x008B78A0 (0x00541420), and clears the 0x100000 flag. Destroys the stream-handle globals 0x008B8DBC/0x008B8DC0 (0x00542E50, 0x00557470, 0x00587BCF). Walks the +0x100 and +0x108 tree lists with TreeActiveCheck (0x00544E20), returning -1 while any active tree remains; otherwise runs TextureFlagTestWithDispatch (0x00557630) over the +0x148 texture list, finishes with 0x00540760(0x008B78A0) and returns 0.

Recursive audio-network tree walk: reads two child pointers a2[17] and a2[19], recurses on each (depth flag 1), aborting with -1 if a subtree reports busy/failure; then walks the linked chain at a2[129] following next pointers at offset 16 while the node is not transform-ready (VertexBufferTransform of flags +0xEC bit 4, 0x0054C6C0). Returns -1 when a ready chain node is found, 0 when the chain terminates.

Recursive scene-graph tree destructor: recurses into child +0x1B0 unconditionally and into child +0x1B8 only when both +0x1AC and +0x1B8 are non-null, removes the node from its doubly linked list (0x00545090), runs the EmptyStub_0170 (0x004B0170) and EmptyStub_7470 (0x00557470) cleanup stubs, and frees the node (0x00587BCF). Invoked by ResourceCleanupDestructionForDirectXObjects (0x00543BF0) during render-side teardown.

3D sound-source destructor owned by an audio manager: recursively destroys sub-sources a2[17] and a2[19] (gated on a2[16]), aborts with -1 while the object is still attached via SceneGraph (0x0054A770), tears down the optional buffer resource at +0x230 (0x00560E50/0x00560F10/0x005459D0/0x00560C00/0x00587BCF), nulls the matching entry in the manager registration array (base this+0x150, count this+0x14C, stride 24), detaches via LinkedListRemove (0x005452B0), runs the destructor chain (0x0054A710) and frees the object.

Pure thiscall getter returning this[68], the dword field at +0x110. No side effects. Its caller set spans rendering, cockpit/gauge setup, vehicle-graphics scene loading, render-target cleanup, queue resource cleanup and flag-set rendering, indicating a widely shared field on a graphics/resource object.

Audio buffer load-ratio computation driving a stored callback: returns 0 immediately when callback global 0x008B8F00 is null; otherwise dispatches on buffer-state global 0x008B8EF8 via jump table jpt_545F6C (0x00545FF8). Case 1 computes (1 - dword_8B8EE8/dword_8B8EF0)*20.0, case 2 computes (1 - Addend(0x008B8EEC)/dword_8B8EF4)*80.0 + 20.0; both clamp to no-op below 0.25 and otherwise invoke the callback with the float; case 3 invokes the callback with literal 1120403456; default returns 0.

Mutex/semaphore-style object cleanup: aborts with -1 when ResourceCleanupDestructionForDirectXObjects (0x00543BF0) fails, unlinks the object (0x0053C630), releases its scene node (0x005437E0) and frees it (0x00587BCF), clears global 0x008B8F28 to 0 and returns 0.

Resource-object constructor/initializer: zero-initializes via GlobalZeroInit (0x0053C2A0), memsets the first 0x40 bytes, writes literal defaults at +0x84..+0xC0 (float 294912.0625 at +0x9C, all-bits-set sentinel at +0xA0, 65538 at +0xAC, float 1.0 at +0xB0, zeros elsewhere), and configures four control channels via IndexedFieldCopy (0x00547140, channels 1-4 with 0xFFFFFF/0) and SwitchBasedFloatSetter (0x005471D0). Returns this.
Range-gated configuration trigger: reads the bound at this+0xA4; when a2 < bound and bound < 8 calls SimpleSetter_fc40 (0x0054FC40) with literal 0x100000; otherwise does nothing. Always returns 0.

Range-gated resource-object configuration: when a2 < this+0xA4 < 8 runs four setters (SimpleSetter_fc40(&unk_800000), DualFieldSetter(0,0) 0x0054FC80, ShortComputation_fd30(1.0,1.0) 0x0054FD30, FieldSetter_fca0(2) 0x0054FCA0) and ORs bit 0x80 into the flags at +0x9C. Returns 0 on both paths.

Conditional render-state setup on the D3D texture-resource path: when a2 < this+0xA4 < 8 applies SimpleSetter_fc40(0x1000000), DualFieldSetter(0,0), ShortComputation_fd30(1.0,1.0) and FieldSetter_fca0(5). Always returns 0. Structurally a twin of sub_546FE0 per cluster analysis.

Guarded render-state set: when the incoming argument is below this+0xA4 and that bound is below 8 applies SimpleSetter_fc40(0x8000000), DualFieldSetter(0,0), ShortComputation_fd30(1.0,1.0) and FieldSetter_fca0(4); always returns 0. Structural twin of sub_546FE0. Called by DirectXMeshVertexBufferParsingAndLoading (0x00547B40) and D3DTextureResourceCreation (0x00548190).

Resource-manager entry point that reuses or allocates a resource: looks up by name (0x00548890) and, when found with a4 flag bit 0x100 clear, bumps the reference count at +136 and returns 0; otherwise allocates a 196-byte object (0x00587C03), initializes it (0x00546250), copies the name (0x00546330), allocates the 148-byte sub-resource array (0x0054FB90), runs conditional validators (0x00546F30, 0x00547100, 0x00546F70), stores config, links the node (0x00547670) and returns 0 (-1 on validator failure).

Appends resource node a2 to the singly linked list rooted at this+0x24 (walking to the tail via each node's next pointer at +0xC0, or making a2 the head on an empty list; sets prev/next links), then increments the total counter this+0x10 and one of four bucket counters (this+0x14/+0x18/+0x1C/+0x20) selected by flag bits 0x20/0x100 of a2[39] (+0x9C). Returns the new total count.

Resource-manager node removal: decrements the node reference count (0x005469C0) and only when it reaches 0 continues: formats an already-deleted message (0x0058815F, global 0x005DBE60) when the state word is -1, decrements one of the four category counters (+0x14..+0x20) selected by bits 0x20/0x100, splices the node out of the doubly linked list (relinking a2[47]/a2[48] neighbor pointers), advances the list head +0x24 if needed, frees internal arrays (0x00546370), runs the stub (0x00557470), frees the node (0x00587BCF), and decrements the total count +0x10.

Mesh/vertex-buffer resource loading: reads a stream in fixed chunks (4 and 32 bytes) via ArithmeticComparison_a5c0 (0x0054A5C0), and per entry allocates a 196-byte resource object (0x00587C03), initializes it (0x00546250), copies its name (0x00546330), applies conditional setters (0x00546F30/0x00546F70), render-state and dimension config (0x005470A0/0x005471C0/0x00547240), a default/field-config group (0x0054FB90, 0x0054FC10, 0x0054FC70, 0x0054FC80, 0x0054FCB0, 0x0054FCC0, 0x0054FD30, 0x0054FD50, 0x0054FDA0, 0x0054FDF0, 0x0054FE00, 0x00552FC0), deduplicates by name (0x005477F0, 0x00546370), generates a random password key for tagged textures (0x00548A30), and appends to the resource list (0x00547670). Reads global 0x008B8F30.

Texture resource loading from a stream: reads an entry count (0x0054A5C0) and per entry allocates and initializes a 196-byte resource object (0x00587C03, 0x00546250), configures flags/dimensions/simple field (0x00547240, 0x005471C0), allocates the 148-byte sub-resource array (0x0054FB90), optionally generates a random name suffix (0x00548A30, 0x00587DD0), deduplicates by name (0x005477F0) or appends (0x00547670), then iterates sub-resources reading render-state tokens and dispatching on element field [24] values (0x00800000 -> 0x00546F70, 0x100000 -> 0x00546F30, 0x400000 -> 0x00546FE0, 0x1000000 -> 0x00547040, 0x8000000 -> 0x005470A0) plus element flags (0x0054FC50, 0x0054FCB0, 0x0054FCC0, 0x0054FD50). Returns 0 when all entries are processed, -1 on render-state setter failure.

Walks the linked list rooted at the head in this[9] (this+0x24) following node next pointers at +0xC0; for each node calls 0x00546450(node, -1) and returns -1 immediately on a non-zero match; otherwise atomically decrements the Addend global (InterlockedDecrement at 0x0059E234/0x008B8EEC) and runs AudioVolumeLoadComputation(0) (0x00545F50), then advances. Returns 0 when the list is empty or the chain ends without a match.

Walks the chain of reference-counted resources rooted at the head in this[9] (this+0x24), releasing each node via ReferenceCountedResourceRelease (0x005469C0) and advancing through each node's next pointer at +0xC0. Returns 0 when the list is empty or the chain ends normally, and -1 when a release returns -1.

classes.name: SceneGraphRenderResourceManager
classes.responsibility: Scene/render resource management object holding draw-element arrays, the scene-graph and audio lists, and four per-bucket vertex-draw arrays; allocation/rebuild is performed by 0x00543FA0.

classes.name: AudioNetworkStreamManager
classes.responsibility: Audio network stream subsystem owner: sub-stream array (count +0x160, ptr +0x164), two tree lists (+0x100/+0x108), a texture list (+0x148), and flags (+0xEC); teardown performed by 0x00544AF0, also consuming the shared audio buffer and stream-handle globals.

classes.name: ResourceObject
classes.responsibility: 196-byte resource object: control-channel state (+0x84..+0xC0), flags (+0x9C), config bound (+0xA4) and sentinel defaults (+0xA0 = -1, +0xAC = 65538, +0xB0 = 1.0); constructed by 0x00546250 and configured by the range-gated setter family 0x00546F30/0x00546F70/0x00547040/0x005470A0, each gated on a2 < this+0xA4 < 8.

classes.name: ResourceManager
classes.responsibility: Resource registry / linked-list manager: singly linked list rooted at +0x24 (node next at +0xC0, list base +0xE4), total count +0x10, and four flag-classified bucket counters +0x14..+0x20; node create/reuse (0x005474D0), append (0x00547670), refcounted remove (0x00547710), and list walks (0x005487A0, 0x005487E0).

classes.name: MeshResourceManager
classes.responsibility: Mesh/vertex-buffer resource loader (0x00547B40): stream-parses 196-byte resource entries (0x0054A5C0), configures them, deduplicates by name, and appends them to the resource list.

classes.name: TextureResourceManager
classes.responsibility: Texture resource loader (0x00548190): stream-parses texture entries with 148-byte sub-resource arrays, random-name suffixing, dedupe, and per-sub-resource render-state dispatch on element field [24] tokens.

classes.name: SceneGraphNode
classes.responsibility: Scene-graph tree node with two child slots (+0x1B0 unconditional, +0x1B8 gated by +0x1AC), doubly linked; recursively destroyed by 0x00544EF0.

classes.name: AudioNetworkNode
classes.responsibility: Audio network tree node: two child slots (a2[17], a2[19]) and a linked chain at a2[129] with next at offset 16; recursively walked by 0x00544D30. Node layout not evidenced as field refs.

classes.name: SoundSource
classes.responsibility: 3D sound-source object owned by an audio manager: sub-source slots a2[16]/a2[17]/a2[19] and an optional buffer resource at +0x230; destroyed by 0x00545150, which also nulls the entry in the manager registration array.

state_machines.name: AudioBufferLoadState
state_machines.transitions: Dispatch on global dword_8B8EF8 via jump table jpt_545F6C (0x00545FF8); cases 1 and 2 clamp to no-op (return 0) when the computed value is below 0.25, otherwise invoke the stored callback 0x008B8F00(0, value); case 3 invokes the callback with literal 1120403456; a null callback (0x008B8F00) short-circuits the whole dispatch to 0.

interfaces.name: IResourceConfigurator
interfaces.purpose: Range-gated resource/render-state configuration family (0x00546F30, 0x00546F70, 0x00546FE0, 0x00547040, 0x005470A0): each member gates on a2 < this+0xA4 < 8 and applies a fixed setter sequence; dispatched by D3DTextureResourceCreation (0x00548190) from sub-resource element field [24] tokens (0x800000, 0x100000, 0x400000, 0x1000000, 0x8000000).

compatibility_contracts.name: ResourceObjectConstructionAndConfiguration
compatibility_contracts.description: Constructing a 196-byte resource object must zero-initialize (0x0053C2A0) and memset the first 0x40 bytes, write sentinel defaults at +0x84..+0xC0 (float 294912.0625 at +0x9C, all-bits-set sentinel at +0xA0, 65538 at +0xAC, float 1.0 at +0xB0), and configure four control channels via IndexedFieldCopy/SwitchBasedFloatSetter; the range-gated setter family (0x00546F30/0x00546F70/0x00547040/0x005470A0) must only fire when the incoming argument is below the bound at +0xA4 and that bound is below 8, and must OR the appropriate flag into +0x9C.

compatibility_contracts.name: ResourceListCounters
compatibility_contracts.description: The resource manager must keep its singly linked list rooted at +0x24 (node next at +0xC0), a total counter at +0x10, and four bucket counters at +0x14/+0x18/+0x1C/+0x20 selected by node flag bits 0x20/0x100; append (0x00547670) must walk to the tail and link, and removal (0x00547710) must decrement the reference count and only splice/free when it reaches 0, decrementing the same counters.

compatibility_contracts.name: AudioNetworkTeardown
compatibility_contracts.description: Audio network teardown (0x00544AF0) must, when owner flags at +0xEC have bit 0x100000 set, destroy the sub-stream array (count +0x160, stride 96, 0x005502C0), unlink it (0x005478B0), free the shared audio buffer global 0x008B78A0 (0x00541420), clear the flag, destroy the stream-handle globals 0x008B8DBC/0x008B8DC0, and refuse finalization (return -1) while any active tree remains in the +0x100/+0x108 tree lists.

compatibility_contracts.name: VertexBufferBucketRebuild
compatibility_contracts.description: Vertex-buffer resource allocation (0x00543FA0) must free and reallocate the 24-byte draw-element array (count +0x14C, ptr +0x150) and the four 528-byte bucket arrays (+0x1B8/+0x1C0/+0x1C8/+0x1D0) sized from counts mirrored at +0x44..+0x50/+0x1B4..+0x1CC, classify elements by flag bits 0x20/0x100 into buckets, and return -1 when any scene/audio walk fails.

unresolved: Owner identity remains UNKNOWN for 0x00545F40, 0x00545F50 and 0x005461B0; they operate on module globals or a single +0x110 getter with no class evidence in the packet.

Equal offsets on distinct this objects are kept in separate classes: +0xEC flags and +0x100/+0x108 list heads appear on both SceneGraphRenderResourceManager and AudioNetworkStreamManager, but common ownership is not proven, so they are not merged.

Fields +0x124/+0x128/+0x12C/+0x130 and *(this+0x154)+0x4C and *(this+0x204)+0xEC/0x104 are listed in the packet for 0x00543FA0/0x00544AF0 but never referenced in the raw source; they are presumably consumed inside the cleanup/walk helpers (0x00544740, 0x00545A10, 0x00545A40, 0x00545BB0, 0x00548850) and cannot be mapped here.

Global jpt_5445A4 (0x00544720, jump table at 0x00544720) is read per the packet but has no reference in the raw source; placement unknown. AudioVolumeLoadComputation globals flt_59E43C/59E7F8/59E8EC/59E990 are listed as reads but are absent from the decompiled source (likely folded/optimized).

ResourceManager (0x005474D0/0x00547670/0x00547710/0x005487A0/0x005487E0) is a DERIVED merge based on identical +0x24 head / +0xC0 next / +0x10..+0x20 counter offsets and the packet's own resource-manager language; shared ownership is not CONFIRMED. Field evidence base "*(this+0xE4)+0xC0" disagrees with the source walk head at this[9]/+0x24; the +0xC0 next-pointer association is the shared fact.

AudioNetworkNode and SoundSource node layouts (a2[16]/a2[17]/a2[19]/a2[140], chain next at offset 16, buffer resource at +0x230) are not evidenced as field refs in the packet and remain unresolved; the -1 early-return meaning ('active tree still in use') is inferred from branch structure, not externally confirmed.

MeshResourceManager (named GUESS by the packet for 0x00547B40) and TextureResourceManager (proposed here for 0x00548190, whose owner is UNKNOWN in the packet) are separate loaders; a shared resource-manager base is possible but not evidenced.
Semantics of the sentinel literals (float 294912.0625 at +0x9C, 65538 at +0xAC, -1 at +0xA0) and of flag bits 0x20/0x100/0x80/0x4/0x100000 across ResourceObject and the two managers are unknown.

For 0x00547B40 the raw source text is truncated; EmptyStub_7470 (0x00557470) and FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF) appear in the callee table with no visible call site, and global 0x008B8F30 (temp-file read buffer, DERIVED prelabel) is read without a visible use.
sub_546450's match condition (drives 0x005487A0's -1 exit), sub_547670's link semantics, and the meaning of the 0x1000000/0x8000000 render-state constants are not resolvable from this packet.
